_comment: The site's own settings (T33.3, ADR-1030). `support` holds the Stripe Payment Links of the WrenDNS Stripe account: one for a one-time gift where the donor chooses the amount, and the monthly supporter tiers, each with the label its button shows. They are public addresses (spec/10 T33.3 lists them); they all return to https://wrendns.com/thanks. A Download and Support section with no link is left out. `note` is an optional plain sentence shown under the links, for what the Stripe page will show the donor. No Stripe key, secret or webhook belongs in this repository, and the site never handles card data: the build refuses anything but a Stripe payment link, and anything shaped like a key. `repoPublic` says whether the GitHub repository is public: while it is false, every GitHub, release and raw-file (install.sh) link on the site is shown as plain text, because those pages answer 404 until launch; set it to true when the repository is made public.
